For it is written: “And Moses was content [vayo’el] … ala means nothing other than an oath, as it is written: “And he…brought him under an oath [ala]”

For it is written: “And Moses was content [vayo’el] to dwell with the man” (Exodus 2:21). The word vayo’el is related to the word ala, and ala means nothing other than an oath, as it is written: “And he…brought him under an oath [ala]”
